profile.summary:

Hello there! My name is Kiet Nguyen and I am a new grad from UCSC who majored in Computer Science and also pursued additional education at App Academy which is an intensive full stack web development program with a < 3 % acceptance rate. I'm eager to work with new technologies and framework , and also working in teams in fast paced environments. I'm currently most interested in creating single page applications where boundless ideas and projects can be made.

•	Evaluated peers' work and created training courses to enhance their productivity and correctness by creating training courses for an increase of 38%

projects.title: Kelp (Yelp Clone)
projects.description:
‘Kelp’ is a full-stack single page application based off of Yelp that’s made with Rails and ReactJs where users can check businesses’ information, post reviews and photos.

Optimized custom search functionality by creating custom queries that improves the database performance by reducing execution time of a search query
Stored user’s image uploads in the cloud using AWS S3 to decrease the load on the server and allowing for improved scalability
Utilized Google Maps API to display businesses’ locations by translating geolocation data depending on user’s search results

projects.title: Alcme
projects.description:
‘Alcme’ is a full-stack page application made with ReactJS and MongoDB where users can choose from a list of food ingredients and will return a list of possible recipes from it.

Queried through Spoonacular’s API to populate the database to reduce the calls to the website and improve the response that displays to frontend.
Implemented a search function where it calls the Spoonacular API with data that the user inputs to filter out recipes that utilizes any of the ingredients chosen.
